note: The AgentX the FINAL VALIDATOR measures with. Committed so a pin change is a visible edit to this file rather than a quiet difference between two hosts. Changing the pin invalidates every measurement taken under the old one -- the same rule the three baseline container images live under. Regenerate only after a deliberate re-install, and re-measure everything afterwards.
why_digest_and_not_version: an unrelated PyPI distribution is also called aiperf 0.12.0, so a version check proves nothing. `direct_url.json` identifies the git commit; this digest is what notices an edit to the installed files afterwards.
